name: Mindbender's Ambition (Adept)

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Smoothbore
perks.desc: Smooth shotgun barrel. Greatly increases range at the cost of more projectile spread.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Barrel Shroud
perks.desc:
Balanced shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Slideways
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.desc: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.desc: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Aggressive(55) Solar Shotgun Special Ammo. "I am both happy and sad that I am, yet again, talking about Mindbender’s Ambition. I am so very over this gun existing but it is certainly a solid aggressive frame shotgun. Being able to focus it makes this shotgun more accessible. Meaning more prevalent and more common. Please just do not bring back Spare Rations. I love that gun but we do not need it. Mindbender’s in PvE sits in an interesting position, it can get adept mods for more oomph, but it also doesn’t roll grave robber to make the use of One-Two Punch. Pugilist is great for more melee energy on Warlocks but not every class needs more melee energy."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Handling or Range. Aggressive(55) Solar Shotgun Special Ammo. "In PvP it might be a tough sell, Aggressive Frames are not the strongest right now. That and you really only need Threat Detector or Surplus to bring up the handling past your barrel and masterwork. There are not a lot of good perks in the fourth column to really let this shotgun shine over something like A Sudden Death."

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 34. PvE first-choice roll for burst damage against Majors and stunned Champions in end-game content. Probably only necessary if you've not already got a good solar shotgun that does the same job. There's a few barrel perk options - Corkscrew Rifling or Barrel Shroud for more handling, or Smallbore for a bit more range. In the mag, Assault Mag or Tactical Mag are two solid choices. Then, in the trait columns Puglist is hard to ignore for melee builds and pairs with Swashbuckler for your bonus damage against beefier enemies. Recommended MW: Handling, with a damage-boosting (Adept Big Ones or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 34. PvE first-choice roll for solar subclasses in end-game content. Probably only necessary if you've not already got a good solar shotgun that does the same job. There's a few barrel perk options - Corkscrew Rifling or Barrel Shroud for more handling, or Smallbore for a bit more range. In the mag, Assault Mag or Tactical Mag are two solid choices. Then, in the trait columns You could use Threat Detector, Lead From Gold or Auto-Loading Holster to pair with Incandescent to use scorch and ignition to clear groups of adds or help with damage to Majors. Recommended MW: Handling, with a damage-boosting (Adept Big Ones or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 34. PvE first-choice roll for burst damage against Majors and Champions in end-game content. Probably only necessary if you've not already got a good solar shotgun that does the same job. We're building into One-Two Punch, so you need to hit all of your pellets - Full Choke should help with that. In the mag, Assault Mag or Tactical Mag are two solid choices. Then, in the trait columns You could use Slideways, Lead From Gold or Auto-Loading Holster to pair with One-Two Punch for big Burst damage against Majors and stunned Champions. Recommended MW: Handling, with a damage-boosting (Adept Big Ones or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE Controller \ M+KB): Recommended MW: Reload “While I am happy Mindbender's Ambition makes a return, I would have rathered a new model or just a new gun. If you cannot tell, I do not really like reissued sunset weapons. Mindbender's is an interesting PvE weapon. It can get incandescent and fills a similar niche to Without Remorse. I would happily craft myself a Without Remorse over trying to farm out an Adept Mindbender's Ambition. There really is not any incentive to get this weapon this season.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Solar Shotgun Special Ammo)

pandapaxxy (PvP Controller): Recommended MW: Handling “In PvP you can make arguments for and against the return of Mindbender's Ambition. On one hand it is still a strong aggressive frame shotgun that can get adept mods. On the other hand so is the Timelost Found Verdict and VoG is less of a challenge. Master VoG will still kick an unprepared ass, but will not be nearly as difficult as it used to be. To make Mindbender's Ambition work in the crucible you will have to invest into range and handling. Threat detector will take up a decent chunk of handling by speeding up the ready animation. But barrel shroud an a handling masterwork paired with quick charge will get you the rest of the way to where you want to be. Fragile focus and accurized rounds will take up your range, so long as you do not get hit to keep fragile focus up.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Solar Shotgun Special Ammo)
